blocks.text: Elastic spring se bandha mass

Ek jism lein jis ka mass m hai aur jo spring constant k wale spring se bandha hai; yeh chikni (smooth, ragar ke baghair) horizontal satah par para hai (Fig. 14.2). Shuru mein jism O par ruka hua hai; O ko mean position (darmiyani jagah) kehte hain. Ab hum jism par force F laga kar use O se A tak daen taraf x faasle tak hilate hain. Hooke's law ke mutabiq lagayi gayi force displacement ke proportional (barabar nisbat mein) hoti hai:

blocks.alt: Teen qataarein; har aik mein deewar se bandhe spring par kamiyat m, hamwar farsh par. (a) Kamiyat darmiyani jagah O par rest mein. (b) Kamiyat kheench kar A tak, O se daen taraf displacement x, aur restoring force F deewar ki taraf. (c) Kamiyat dhakel kar B tak, O se baen taraf displacement x, spring daba hua.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.2: Spring se bandhi kamiyat S.H.M karte hue (kitab ki Figure 14.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki figure mein (c) qatar mein dabe spring wale mass ke ilawa daen taraf ek aur alag block 'B' bhi chhapa hai; yeh ghalti hai. Text ke mutabiq B woh jagah hai jahan spring daba hua ho, yani O se baen taraf x faasle par, aur khaake mein B wahin hai. Dono taraf restoring force hamesha O ki taraf hoti hai.
Isi waqt spring bhi jism par apni elastic restoring force lagata hai jo lagayi gayi force ke barabar magar ulti simt (opposite direction) mein hoti hai:

Jab lagayi gayi force hata kar jism ko chhora jaye to woh O ki taraf chalta hai, inertia (apni harkat jaari rakhne ki aadat) ki wajah se O se aage nikal kar B tak pohanchta hai aur spring ko daba deta hai; phir wapas aata hai aur A aur B ke darmiyan jhoolne lagta hai.

blocks.title: Simple harmonic motion
blocks.text: S.H.M karne wale jism ka acceleration hamesha displacement ke directly proportional hota hai aur hamesha mean position ki taraf hota hai.
Time period aur frequency

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne aakhri line T = 2π√(k/m) chhapi hai. Sahi T = 2π√(m/k) hai, kyun ke T, f = (1/2π)√(k/m) ka ulat (reciprocal) hai, is liye root ke andar m/k aata hai. Matlab: mass bhari ho to period lamba; spring sakht (k bara) ho to period chhota.

blocks.title: Point to ponder!
blocks.text: S.H.M ka usool asal zindagi mein yahan kaam aata hai: pendulum wali ghariyan (clocks), musical instruments aur gariyon ka suspension system.

blocks.title: Example 14.1
blocks.problem: S.H.M karne wale ek zarre (particle) ki angular frequency 2 rad s⁻¹ hai. Is ki frequency aur time period nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: ω = 2 rad s⁻¹. Maloom karna hai: f = ? aur T = ?
Dono taraf 2 se taqseem (divide) karein: f = 1/π ≈ 1/3.14 ≈ 0.318 Hz
blocks.answer: Frequency taqreeban 0.318 Hz aur time period taqreeban 3.14 s (kitab ise 'taqreeban 3 seconds' likhti hai).

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Dutch mathematician, astronomer aur physicist Christiaan Huygens ne 1656 mein pehli pendulum wali ghari (pendulum clock) patent karayi. Unhon ne simple harmonic motion ki madad se pendulum ki lambai aur waqt ka formula pakka kiya.
Simple pendulum
Simple pendulum mein ek chhota, bhari aur thos bob (mass m) hota hai jo ek mazboot sahare (rigid support) se halki aur na khinchne wali (inextensible) dori ke zariye latka hota hai.

Jab pendulum ko mean position O se kuch angle par extreme position P tak le ja kar chhora jaye to us par mean position ki taraf restoring force lagti hai. Is force ki wajah se pendulum gravity ke asar mein O ke gird ek mure hue (curved) raaste par aage peeche jhoolne lagta hai (Fig. 14.3-b).

blocks.alt: (a) Sahare se latakta simple pendulum darmiyani jagah aur dono intehai jagahon par, doriyon aur mure raaste ke saath teer. (b) Bob intehai jagah P par, l lambai ki dori O se guzarti amudi lakeer se theta zawiya banati. Tension T dori ke saath oopar; wazan mg neeche, jo dori ke saath mg cos theta aur O ki taraf mg sin theta mein toota hai. O se P tak qaus (arc) S aur ufqi displacement x hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.3: Simple pendulum, (a) intehai jagahon ke darmiyan jhoolta aur (b) P par bob par quwwatein (kitab ki Figure 14.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab Fig. 14.3 ka sirf hissa (a), yani jhoolta pendulum, chhapti hai; hissa (b), jis ka text zikr karta hai, chhapa hi nahi. Is liye (b) text ke mutabiq banaya gaya hai. (b) mein dekhein: wazan mg do hisson (components) mein toot-ta hai. Dori ke saath wala hissa mg cosθ tension T ke barabar ho kar khatam ho jata hai, aur dori par perpendicular (amood) hissa mg sinθ bob ko O ki taraf wapas kheenchta hai: yahi restoring force hai. Chhote angle par arc S aur x taqreeban barabar hain.

Extreme position P par bob ka wazan (weight) dori ki simt se angle θ banata hai. Wazan ko do rectangular components mein torte hain. Pendulum dori ki simt mein harkat nahi karta, is liye component mg cosθ aur dori ka tension T ek hi lakeer par ulti simton mein hain aur ek doosre ko khatam kar dete hain. blocks.title: Brain teaser
blocks.text: Har thartharati cheez awaz paida karti hai. Phir jhoolta simple pendulum awaz kyun paida nahi karta?

blocks.prompt: Brain teaser ka jawab: jhoolta pendulum sunayi dene wali awaz kyun paida nahi karta?
blocks.explanation: Pendulum ki frequency bohat kam hai (second pendulum ki sirf 0.5 Hz). Insaan sirf taqreeban 20 Hz se 20 000 Hz tak ki awaz sun sakta hai, is liye pendulum se paida hone wali halki si hawa ki lehar sunayi nahi deti.

blocks.title: Brain teaser
blocks.text: Agar pendulum Lahore se Karachi le jaya jaye to kya us ka time period badlega?

blocks.prompt: Brain teaser ka jawab: Lahore se Karachi le jane par pendulum ka time period badlega?
blocks.explanation: Bohat thora sa. T = 2π√(ℓ/g) aur g jagah ke saath zara sa badalta hai: Karachi Lahore ke muqable mein Equator (khatt-e-istiwa) ke zyada qareeb hai, is liye wahan g thora kam hai aur T bohat thora lamba ho jata hai. Farq itna chhota hai ke aam stopwatch se maloom nahi hota, lekin pendulum ghari Karachi mein thori si susti (slow) chalegi.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Lafz 'pendulum' Latin lafz 'pendulus' se bana hai, jis ka matlab hai 'latakta hua'.

Yeh formula batata hai ke simple pendulum ka time period dori ki lambai ke square root ke directly proportional aur g ke square root ke inversely proportional (ulat tanasub mein) hai. Time period bob ke mass m aur amplitude par munhasir nahi (chhote amplitude ke liye).
Jo pendulum ek vibration do second mein poori kare, yani jis ka time period 2 s ho, use second pendulum kehte hain.
Simple pendulum se g napna

Simple pendulum se kisi jagah ka gravitational acceleration g maloom kiya ja sakta hai. Pendulum ki lambai ℓ napein, use jhulayein aur stopwatch se time period T napein. Phir Eq. (14.10) ko is shakal mein likh kar g nikalein:

blocks.title: Example 14.2
blocks.problem: Second pendulum ki lambai kya hai? Us jagah us ki frequency bhi nikalein jahan g = 9.8 m s⁻² ho.
steps: Diya gaya: T = 2 s, g = 9.8 m s⁻². Maloom karna hai: ℓ = ?
ℓ ko alag karein: ℓ = gT²/4π² = (9.8 m s⁻²)(2 s)² / 4(3.14)² = 39.2/39.44
Frequency (kitab ne nahi nikali): f = 1/T = 1/2 s = 0.5 Hz
blocks.answer: Second pendulum ki lambai taqreeban 0.994 m (99.4 cm) aur frequency 0.5 Hz hai.

blocks.title: Brain teaser
blocks.text: Agar lambai wahi rahe to kya simple pendulum ka time period Zameen aur chaand par barabar hoga?

blocks.prompt: Brain teaser ka jawab: kya pendulum ka time period Zameen aur chaand par barabar hoga?
blocks.explanation: Nahi. T = 2π√(ℓ/g). Chaand par g Zameen ka taqreeban 1/6 hai, is liye T taqreeban √6 ≈ 2.45 guna lamba ho jata hai: Zameen par 2 s wala pendulum chaand par taqreeban 4.9 s leta hai.

blocks.title: Brain teaser
blocks.text: Simple pendulum ka time period napte waqt chhota amplitude lene ka mashwara kyun diya jata hai?

blocks.prompt: Brain teaser ka jawab: time period napte waqt chhota amplitude kyun?
blocks.explanation: Formula T = 2π√(ℓ/g) is farz (assumption) par bana hai ke sinθ ≈ θ, jo sirf chhote angles (taqreeban 10° tak) par sahi hai. Bare jhoolon mein harkat poori tarah S.H.M nahi rehti aur period formula se thora lamba aata hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Mass-spring: F = −kx, a = −(k/m)x; ω = √(k/m), f = (1/2π)√(k/m), T = 2π√(m/k).
Simple pendulum: restoring force mg sinθ; chhote angle par sinθ ≈ θ, a = −(g/ℓ)x.
ω = √(g/ℓ), T = 2π√(ℓ/g): mass aur (chhote) amplitude par munhasir nahi; second pendulum T = 2 s, ℓ ≈ 0.994 m.
g = 4π²ℓ/T² se kisi jagah ka g napa ja sakta hai.
